metadata.headline: Temu was fined €200M. Can more products weaken the platform?

platform_lesson.title: More supply can scale risk as well as value
platform_lesson.text: Temu's marketplace growth loop depends on more Shoppers attracting more Sellers, more Sellers adding more Products, and more choice and price competition attracting more Shoppers again. The DSA case exposes the other side of that loop: the same discovery and promotion systems can also increase the reach of unsafe or illegal products. Stronger governance may add friction and reduce raw supply, but it can still strengthen the platform if it raises the quality of what remains. The strongest marketplace is not the one with the most products. It is the one where additional products create more value than risk.

core_value_unit.explanation: The Product is the Core Value Unit in this EU marketplace case: the item a Shopper can discover, compare and order through Temu.

metrics.note: Global Temu scale metric, not EU-only. Temu's current global Affiliate Program page advertises a catalog of more than 100 million high-converting items. This is a global catalog-scale metric, not an EU-only count.

actor.explanation: Shoppers are the Consumer side: people looking for inexpensive products and deals in Temu's EU marketplace.

metrics.note: Global Temu scale metric, not EU-only. Sensor Tower reported a record 530 million monthly active users globally in August 2025. This is an app audience metric, not a count of EU Buyers.

job.explanation: Shoppers come looking for useful products at prices that feel like a deal.

gain.explanation: Low price and broad choice are central parts of Temu's value proposition to Shoppers.

pain.explanation: A cheap product stops being a bargain when it is unsafe, illegal, non-compliant or materially different from what the listing suggests.

transaction.explanation: Once a Shopper chooses a Product, interest turns into an order and payment.

filter.explanation: Participation depends primarily on Temu serving the Shopper's market and the Product being available there.

access_channel.explanation: Temu's app and website are the main access channels into the marketplace.

activities.explanation: Shoppers search, scroll, compare and buy products.

resources.explanation: Shopper attention and behavior create data about clicks, ignored offers and purchases that can feed discovery and recommendation.

actor.explanation: Outside businesses supply the Products. They form the Provider side of the marketplace and can include merchants, manufacturers and brands.

metrics.note: Global Temu scale metric, not EU-only. Marketplace Pulse estimated more than 300,000 Temu Sellers globally in August 2024. This is an external estimate, not an official Temu count, and it predates the subsequent expansion of local Seller programs.

job.explanation: Sellers join because Temu can expose their Products to a much larger pool of potential Buyers.

gain.explanation: Marketplace attention can translate into more reach and sales.

pain.explanation: Selling through Temu brings platform rules, intense price competition and the cost and effort of getting goods to customers.

transaction.explanation: Sellers bring the goods and pay for services connected with marketplace transactions and promotion.

filter.explanation: Temu's EU Seller Center requires identity or company documentation before a business can start selling.

access_channel.explanation: Approved Sellers manage Products, orders and logistics through Temu's Seller Portal.

activities.explanation: Sellers update stock, manage Products and orders and arrange shipping.

resources.explanation: Sellers contribute the underlying inventory, Product information and the documentation needed to participate.

actor.explanation: Promoters are creators, deal pages and other affiliate-program participants that bring outside audiences and traffic into Temu.

metrics.note: Global Temu scale metric, not EU-only. Temu's current Affiliate Program page states that the program is trusted by more than 50 million Affiliate Partners across 80+ countries and regions. This is not an EU-only Promoter count.

job.explanation: Promoters turn outside attention into visits and qualifying orders.

gain.explanation: Successful referrals can generate commissions or rewards.

pain.explanation: Promoter income depends on program rules and retaining enough credibility with an outside audience.

transaction.explanation: Outside traffic moves toward Temu while qualifying referrals can earn money in return.

filter.explanation: Access to this role comes through Temu's Affiliate or related promoter program.

access_channel.explanation: Referral links and codes connect an outside audience back to the marketplace.

activities.explanation: Promoters share products, deals and recommendations outside Temu's own app and advertising.

resources.explanation: Promoters contribute attention and an audience Temu did not have to build itself.

actor.explanation: Temu operates the marketplace between Shoppers, Sellers and Promoters, sets participation rules, shapes discovery and helps transactions happen.

job.explanation: Temu's job is to make useful transactions happen at scale by connecting demand with outside supply.

gain.explanation: More successful purchases can increase the value of Temu's merchant transaction and marketing services.

pain.explanation: As the marketplace scales, unsafe or illegal Products can also gain more opportunities to be discovered and promoted.

transaction.explanation: Temu coordinates the match and helps the purchase move from discovery to payment.

governance.explanation: Temu governs who can sell, what can remain on the marketplace and how Products are ranked or recommended.

promotion_channel.explanation: Advertising, discounts, deals and referrals push additional demand into the platform.

activities.explanation: Temu simultaneously helps Products get found and reviews marketplace risks, Sellers, Products and content against its rules.

resources.explanation: A large audience attracts supply while Shopper behavior provides data that helps Temu decide what to surface next.

current.explanation: When a Shopper buys, the order ultimately reaches the Seller through the platform-mediated transaction.
The Seller provides the Product the Shopper ultimately receives.
The Shopper's payment moves through Temu's marketplace flow.
Temu shapes Product discovery through search, recommendations and deals.
Sellers pay for services connected with transactions and promotion.
Temu gives Sellers access to a large pool of potential Buyers.
Promoters pull people toward Products through deals, links and recommendations.
When a referral qualifies, Temu can return part of the value as a commission or reward.
Referral clicks and visits bring additional demand into Temu's marketplace.

metrics.note: Global Temu scale metric, not EU-only. Sensor Tower, August 2025; app MAU, not EU Buyers.
Global Temu scale metric, not EU-only. Marketplace Pulse estimate, August 2024; not an official Temu count.
Global Temu scale metric, not EU-only. Temu Affiliate Program; current global figure across 80+ markets.
